name: Shiori
message: "Ah! This is where we first tried an urban legend out, right? I never imagined another world actually existed..."

name: Shiori
message: "Speaking of other worlds, I wonder if the one you can reach from here is connected to that mirror world you were spirited away to."

name: Shiori
message: "No matter where we looked, it was the same scenery stretching on and on... in a way, maybe it really was like a reflection. It felt so eerie..."

name: Shiori
message: "There was that really weird aberration too... It even tried to trick you using my voice."

name: Shiori
message: "I froze up for a moment back then. I never expected it to go that far."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm glad you stayed calm... If you followed it without a second thought, who knows what could've happened..."

name: Shiori
message: "I guess I can only say this because we made it back safe, but... it was fun, wasn't it? Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "My heart was racing the whole time. It felt like I was in a movie. I can't believe I got to experience that with you."

name: Shiori
message: "That goes for the other urban legends too. They may not have had anything to do with my memories, but I'm glad you went along with me."

name: Shiori
message: "They've turned into really wonderful memories, truly irreplaceable ones."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, did I sound too dramatic? I really mean it, though."

name: Shiori
message: "Searching for my lost memories, recording different ways I could've died, and sometimes taking detours to chase after urban legends..."

name: Shiori
message: "I only realized just now that the journey itself was what really mattered."

name: Shiori
message: "If I could, I'd want to do so many more things with you, and..."

name: Shiori
message: "We should go. Standing around in the middle of the road like this is dangerous."
